cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you catch that bus: you said work kept you till six. Why's your taxi receipt timed five?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll explain tomorrow. That's the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'll drive you. What happened to that hour?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I left at five. I stopped somewhere before I came home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you home after you tell me where you stopped. Sit down; I've got all evening.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 last-bus pressure causes A3 ride offer; B4 partial admission causes A5 narrower condition.

relationship.evidence: B2 has a real departure deadline and B4 admits only part of the discrepancy.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes the replacement transport conditional on the still-missing location supplied by B4.

specificity.evidence: A1 six versus five and B2 last bus give a concrete discrepancy and immediate pressure.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 all evening contrasts with B2 last bus and makes A's control playable.
